scene.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original full-scene art direction keyframe for a first-person psychological horror game: believable old domestic bedroom opening into an eerily long institutional corridor. Use supplied bedroom board as furniture identity and material reference. The goal is sophisticated found-footage / pseudo-documentary realism with subtle artistic hand-painted surfaces. Attractive restrained composition, unsettling and coherent, not ugly random surrealism.
Wide cinematic landscape 16:9, human eye-height documentary camera from just inside doorway, 32mm lens, only slight handheld imperfect framing, no dramatic Dutch angle. Foreground left a complete narrow old dark wood bed with worn iron headboard and faded dusty mauve quilt and cream pillow, natural rumples with NO human-shaped lump. Midground a worn desk, simple chair, tall bookcase, one eerie framed portrait with slightly wrong eye alignment. Visible central path through an open doorway into a receding corridor. Ceiling has an old modest chandelier in bedroom; two spaced linear fluorescent strips in corridor. No people or monsters.
Lighting has deliberate hierarchy: a muted warm ivory bedside lamp reveals bed fabric and wood as the main readable pool; cold petrol-green fluorescent light shapes the corridor into repeated rectangles; distant very small dim oxblood-red doorway accent provides one mysterious focal point. Dark lavender ambient shadows, lifted enough to see silhouettes. No full-screen red wash, no rainbow lighting, no pure black hiding props. Soft indirect bounce, directional shadows, slight dusty air only at lights. Walls desaturated gray-green paint above old dark timber skirting, floor worn wide boards with tiny restrained sheen. Narrow curtains dusty rose. 70 percent desaturated dark neutral, 25 percent petrol green and faded mauve, 5 percent red accent.
Materials read physically real: dry wood grain, coarse faded cloth weave, tarnished metal, peeling wall paint. Subtle controlled brush-made color shapes in surface/albedo and fine imperfect hand-drawn framed art, while actual volume and light remain credible 3D; no flat illustration lines or painterly smearing. Found-footage character is restrained fine sensor grain, mild corner softness, tiny halation only on lights; no scanline overlays, huge color splitting or burned highlights.
Quiet beauty and discomfort: carefully arranged negative space, slightly asymmetric picture alignment, identical corridor fixtures repeating too far. No gore, skull decorations, occult spam, floating debris, impossible fused furniture, grotesque random deformation, logos, captions, UI or text. This is a proposed visual target, not a screenshot of implemented gameplay.

sheets.title: 空客厅 · 预设 02
sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a landscape production approval sheet for a coherent first-person psychological horror game's indoor asset library.
Use the supplied old bedroom asset board as material/color/design-family reference ONLY; replace the furniture with the specified set. Real-time 3D game asset render appearance with clear geometric volumes and real physical wood grain, cloth weave, dull metal wear. Subtle artistic hand-painted variation is intentional in the albedo: broad restrained pigment patches, carefully edited edge wear and delicate drawn details, while the object retains convincing three-dimensional physical lighting. No heavy outlines, muddy brushwork, generalized paper overlay or flat watercolor flattening. Surface wear is actual material texture, broad low-poly geometry stays readable. Matte and high roughness, a carefully harmonized dusty domestic palette: desaturated petrol-green shadows, faded lavender/rose fabric, bone-cream paper, small oxblood accents; each object has a dominant neutral and only one restrained accent. Things are old and unsettling but still plausibly functional, with subtle asymmetry and eerie absence. No bloody gore, no monsters, no eyeballs attached to every object, no neon, no glossy plastic, no luxury polish.
Composition: a neatly spaced grid of isolated complete objects on plain neutral warm-gray background, each in consistent three-quarter view, generous margins, soft diffuse studio light, no room walls or floor platforms, no huge dark cast shadows. Every requested asset once, clearly separate, not touching another. Text only the exact Chinese title and short labels specified; restrained legible typography. Keep all complete silhouettes, no cropping. This is a 2D art approval sheet, not a final 3D output.
